questionProposals.assessedUnderstanding: Recognize uncontrolled ordering of concurrent updates to shared state as a race condition; no specific TOCTOU check-use sequence is supplied.
questionProposals.contentQualification: HOLD simultaneous writes as necessary for every race, fatal memory faults as inevitable, or this general shared-state scenario as a separate TOCTOU decision. Synchronisation/atomic-operation teaching is not tested code or proof of safe concurrency. Compare with m248 conservatively at race-family level; subtype novelty remains pending.

questionProposals.assessedUnderstanding: Choose prevention of shared caching of private responses and validation of isolation for the specified disclosure; whole numbered assessment scope held.
questionProposals.contentQualification: HOLD precise whole-item 2.3 assessment scope: the offered decision chooses a mitigation, whereas 2.3 is vulnerability explanation. questionProposals.assessedUnderstanding: Recognize substitution of a file reference between permission check and actual read as TOCTOU; not every symlink or race is that precise subtype.
questionProposals.contentQualification: HOLD symlink existence alone as TOCTOU, generic privilege escalation/IDOR as independently tested, or reducing the race window/repeating separate checks as eliminating the race. The file permission check and substituted resource at use support the precise contrast. Atomic/resource-bound checks are conditional teaching, not implemented or validated defense; correlated race-family evidence remains zero.
